title: Add a flag and an error path to a small CLI
prompt: src/cli.mjs prints the word count of a file. Add a --json flag (accepted before or after the file name) that prints one line of JSON instead: {"file": <the path as given>, "words": <n>, "lines": <n>}. Lines: a final newline does not start a new line and an empty file has 0 lines. When the file does not exist, print a message starting with "error:" to stderr (no stack trace) and exit with code 2. Without --json the output stays exactly as it is.
